statement: Whenever diagonal_sum(mat) returns a result r, r = P + S - C, where P = sum over i from 0 to n-1 of mat[i][i], S = sum over i from 0 to n-1 of mat[i][n-1-i], and C = mat[(n-1)/2][(n-1)/2] if n is odd, or C = 0 if n is even.
preconditions: Let n = len(mat). Assume 1 <= n <= 100; for every i with 0 <= i < n, len(mat[i]) = n; and for every i,j with 0 <= i < n and 0 <= j < n, 1 <= mat[i][j] <= 100. All indices below are 0-based.

statement: Let m = 2*n - (1 if n is odd else 0). Whenever diagonal_sum(mat) returns r, m <= r <= 100*m.
